description: This file implements the ClientClusterManifestProvider class, which manages the retrieval, updating, and dissemination of cluster manifest information for external clients within the Orleans distributed framework. It handles starting and stopping the provider service, asynchronously updating manifests from gateways, merging partial updates, and exposing current and recent states of the cluster manifest.

classes.name: ClientClusterManifestProvider
classes.description: Manages cluster manifest information for external clients, including retrieval, updates, and synchronization with gateways, supporting asynchronous start and stop operations, and providing observables for current and updated manifests.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Initializes and starts the provider asynchronously, setting up background tasks for updating manifests.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Gracefully stops the provider, canceling ongoing tasks.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Background loop that periodically fetches and merges cluster manifest updates from gateways.

methods.name: GetClusterManifestUpdate
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the latest cluster manifest update from the provider; falls back to older API if necessary.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of resources, signaling shutdown and awaiting task completion.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Synchronously disposes of resources, signaling shutdown.
